name: Bases View Extract
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Preset save and delete now read data.json first, so a preset that sync added on another device is kept.
Delete preset with no selection shows an error.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Saving or deleting a preset no longer removes a preset synced from another device.
Deleting a preset with nothing selected now shows an error.
tip: Select Copy to clipboard to copy the complete query block with its shared definitions.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases View Extract is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
